services.title: What can we fix for you?

cards.title: Doorstep Service
cards.short: We repair it at your door
cards.eta: Technician at your door in about 60 minutes
cards.steps: Book a slot | Technician arrives | Repaired on the spot
cards.body: A technician rides to your home or office with parts and tools. Phones and laptops are fixed in front of you; printers, CCTV and Wi-Fi are installed and serviced on-site.

cards.title: Pickup & Service
cards.short: We collect, repair and return it
cards.eta: Picked up same day, back in 24–48 hours
cards.steps: Rider picks up | Repaired in our lab | Delivered back
cards.body: A rider collects the phone, laptop, printer or drive, our lab repairs it, and it comes back to the same address.

trust.text: Not listed? Book anyway — we confirm

items.q: Is there a charge if you only inspect the device?
items.a: No. Diagnosis and the visit or pickup are shown as OMR 0 — you get an estimate before any work starts.

items.q: How long does a repair take?
items.a: Most phone and laptop repairs are done on the spot during a doorstep visit. Pickup repairs come back in 24–48 hours; board-level work can take longer and we tell you upfront.

items.q: Which devices can be repaired at my door?
items.a: Phones, tablets, laptops, desktops and printers can be done at your door or picked up. CCTV and networking are always installed on-site.
Your data stays on your device. We only access what the repair needs, and data recovery jobs are handled in our lab.
Areas around our 3 branches — Ruwi, Muscat, Sohar, Salalah. Check your area in the coverage section above.
